title: chore(ui): re-pin the console eager-closure ceiling after the spec shared chunks
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9VQKUCrmuRDnacLPUeKUV3p)_

Part of #25925

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

Re-pins the console eager-closure budget in `ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` onto a reading of `main`, and moves the two rendered-reading literals its unit test pins. Nothing reaches a bundler input, nothing under `ui/packages/**` changes, so the sdui manifest record does not move.

| constant | before | after |
|---|---:|---:|
| `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` | 3,579,945 | 2,489,948 (down 1,089,997) |
| `BASELINE` | 3,072,056 · 85 of 2291 · `b6f11d3` | 1,982,059 · 85 of 2387 · `cc378e93` |
| `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS['vendor-objectstack']` | 1,867,000 | 842,730 (down 1,024,270) |
| `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE['vendor-objectstack']` | 1,531,986 | 507,716 |

Each line comes down by exactly what its payload lost, so each keeps the headroom it had: aggregate 507,889 bytes (0.71x the 695 KiB regression), `vendor-objectstack` 335,014 (0.47x). The other three per-chunk rows stayed in range and are untouched.

## Why

On `main` at `cc378e93` the gate exits 2: its headroom-sensitivity half calls the aggregate ceiling (1560.4 KB of headroom, 2.25x) and the `vendor-objectstack` row (1327.4 KB, 1.91x) blind. The closure shrank by about a third since the objectui-era baseline, almost all of it `vendor-objectstack`, after `@objectstack/spec` moved to one shared-chunk ESM graph (`3a2d38c6e2`) and objectui moved into this repository as `ui/`. How the drop splits between those two is not measured.

## Readings (one container, one instrument)

`pnpm --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build`, then `CI=true pnpm exec vite build` in `ui/apps/console`, both under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0), reading `ui/apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`.

| build | eager gz bytes | chunks | `vendor-objectstack` gz |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `main` `cc378e93` (control) | 1,982,059 | 85 of 2387 | 507,716 |
| `cc378e93` again, after the edit (re-read) | 1,982,059 | 85 of 2387 | 507,716 |
| experiment: both `SystemFieldName` imports replaced by a local literal, uncommitted | 1,981,898 | 85 of 2387 | 507,693 |

The experiment moved the aggregate by -161 bytes (largest moves: `vendor-objectstack` -23, `ui-components` -19, `index` -16): zero saving. On-disk proof before its build: marker count 1 and old-import count 0 in both files; restored with `git checkout HEAD --` under a trap, both blob hashes equal to HEAD's and `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards. The console aliases workspace packages to `src`, so the build read the mutated sources.

## Gate output on this branch

`node scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` after the re-pin: closure ✅ 1935.6 KB / 2431.6 KB, per-chunk ✅ ×4, sensitivity ✅ ×5 (aggregate 0.71x, `vendor-objectstack` 0.47x). It still exits 1 on the membership half, which this PR does not touch (see Acceptance notes).

## Acceptance notes

- The card's first step, repointing the two `SystemFieldName` imports at `@objectstack/spec/data`, is not possible: `packages/spec/src/data/index.ts` re-exports no `SystemFieldName` (it is declared in `packages/spec/src/system/constants/system-names.ts` and reaches consumers through `system/index.ts` only), so the repoint would fail type-check. It would also save nothing: `FlowRunner.tsx` and `flowResponse.ts` in app-shell still import `/system` by value, and the local-literal experiment above measured -161 bytes. Both import lines are left as they are.
- The membership half reds on `main` before and after this change: "`packages/core` is declared in `framework` but 1 in `vendor-objectstack` (89 of its 90 modules landed in `framework`)". Which module moved is not measured here. Its fix lives in the grouping rules in `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`, outside this card's file surface, and the gate itself says not to move a ceiling to absorb it.
- No workflow under `.github/workflows/` runs `check:eager-closure` today, so the gate is local-only until the ui CI lands; this re-pin makes it meaningful again when it does.
- The spec half of #25925 (re-exporting `stripReadDecorations` / `ValidateDataIssueSchema` from a subpath the console already loads) is `domain:spec` work and is not addressed here.

## Tests

- `./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --maxWorkers=2` in `ui/` over `scripts/__tests__/check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts` plus the five other test files that name the checker (`check-eager-locale-catalogues`, `check-side-effects-array`, `vite-declared-lazy-views`, `vite-types-zod-lazy`, `vite-ineffective-dynamic-imports`): Test Files 6 passed (6), Tests 300 passed (300). Before the literal move, the same run failed exactly the two cases that pin the rendered reading.
- No changeset: `ui/scripts/**` belongs to the private `object-ui-monorepo` root and publishes nothing.
